ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.
